steps: Wait after failed run; compare UI item with run and Knowledge Base state.
expected result: Every item reaches terminal state when parent run is failed.

steps: Click Run ingestion, then try browser Cancel run.

scenario: Warning, strict, optional and language decisions
steps: Run warning/failing/optional/mixed-language files through saved v3 and inspect decisions.

Migrations 0027-0028, UI and worker now persist these decisions and publish exact successful membership. See EX-063 through EX-065 for additional language branches.

scenario: Cross-page PDF chunk lacks page attribution
steps: Run v6 on encrypted two-page PDF; inspect chunk 8 in published passages; query the page-2 answer through Test retrieval.
expected result: Page-2 answer has page-2 provenance in stored passage and retrieval evidence.
actual result: Browser rerun of two-page PDF published index v2. Stored answer chunk and rank-1 retrieval evidence both cite PDF page 2.
notes: Root cause: section-token chunking grouped same-section blocks across a page boundary and dropped the page number. Page-bounded chunking v2 reprocessed the immutable source; run 1e72a6ae-8186-46b4-a455-fc1e0f72d81f.

scenario: Automatic fallback on raster-only rotated PDF
steps: Save OCR Automatic fallback v14; run from browser; inspect persisted page 2.
expected result: Low-native-text pages use OCR and retain per-page fallback/rotation evidence.
actual result: Browser run succeeded and published index v3; page 2 records OCR, native text below 20 characters, 90° applied, confidence 96.4/100, and nine compasses.
notes: Run 8976c8b5-3dfa-44bb-adb0-bf6e9d11556f. Full UI → API → worker → persisted inspector path.

steps: Run saved v12 with warning source marked optional and good source required; rerun v13 with warning source required.
expected result: Optional policy excludes only the bad source; required failure terminates siblings and preserves previous ready index.
actual result: v12 published one-member ready index with bad item excluded; v13 failed, bad item failed and good item cancelled, without publishing over the ready index.
notes: Browser run and index inspectors. Required failure screenshot: ex-040-terminal-items.png.

steps: Save v15 from v10 with French and English files, en allowlist, Exclude and report; run from browser and inspect the published index.
expected result: French file is excluded and reported; English file alone is searchable in a ready index.
actual result: Initial browser run failed both-file publication, exposing lost exclusion reason. After fix, French item was excluded, English item succeeded, and ready index v1 contained only the English passage.
notes: Root cause: processing persisted a generic failed status/message, so ingestion could not distinguish language exclusion from an ordinary quality failure. Migration 0028 adds a safe failure code, and the worker honors language_excluded. Run-details screenshot: ex-063-language-excluded-published.png.

steps: Save v16 from v11 with Mixed-language Warn; run from browser and inspect persisted extracted content.

actual result: Browser run published ready index v1; persisted content showed quality decision warn and warning · mixed languages.
notes: Real mixed English/Cyrillic QA fixture; no mock response or API-only result.

steps: Save v17 from v16 with Mixed-language Allow; run from browser and inspect persisted extracted content.
expected result: Mixed document publishes with quality decision pass and no mixed-language warning finding.
actual result: Browser run published ready index v1; persisted content showed quality decision pass, mixed detected, and no mixed-language warning.
notes: Completes Fail, Warn and Allow runtime decisions with EX-050 and EX-064.
